image_description: A close-up portrait of a fair-skinned man with red hair and freckles. He is looking directly at the camera. A small, beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) is applied to his right cheek, just below the eye. The background is dimly lit and out of focus, showing a wall hanging.

The bandage exhibits the standard shape: a narrow strip with visibly rounded ends.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a medical adhesive bandage and not a similar-looking artifact or sticker.
To verify the boundary between the bandage and the skin is sharp and physically plausible, checking for edge bleeding or fusion artifacts common in AI generations.
To ensure the human subject does not exhibit structural anomalies (melting features, asymmetry) that might indicate the whole image is AI-generated, which would cast doubt on the bandage's realism.
To confirm the bandage sits correctly on top of the skin surface with appropriate depth separation, rather than appearing embedded or floating.

focus_areas: Edge integrity of the bandage against the skin
Texture consistency of the central pad vs. adhesive wings
Lighting and shadow consistency under the bandage edges
Anatomical correctness of the human face
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the bandage and the skin. AI often fails to render the slight shadow or displacement caused by an adhesive object on soft tissue. Verify if the bandage looks 'pasted on' digitally or physically adhered. Also, check the human face for any subtle warping around the area where the bandage is applied.
